test_title: PYST 3: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which state is leading with the highest number of solar power installations under PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana (PMSGMBY) by March 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gujarat** is one of the leading states in **solar power generation** in India and continues to hold its position due to favorable policies, geographic advantages, and significant investments.
 
• The state has implemented ambitious renewable energy programs, including the **PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana (PMSGMBY)**, which aims to provide solar-powered electricity to households.
 
• Under the scheme, Gujarat has aggressively promoted the installation of **rooftop solar panels**, encouraging households and industries to adopt solar energy. *Hence, Gujarat is leading in solar power installations.*
 
• **Geographical advantage:** Gujarat's climate and geographic location receive abundant **solar radiation**, making it suitable for large-scale solar power production.
 
• Gujarat has established dedicated **solar parks** such as the **Charanka Solar Park**, which is one of the largest in India. These initiatives are part of the state's renewable energy goals. *Hence, Gujarat has emerged as the leader in solar installations.*
 
• **Policy framework:** Gujarat has introduced strong policy measures to promote renewable energy, including subsidized loans, incentives for rooftop solar installations, and partnerships with private players.
 
• These policies have accelerated the adoption of solar energy and contributed to the state’s leadership in implementing the **PMSGMBY**. *Hence, Gujarat is the correct answer.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana (PMSGMBY):**

 
 
• This scheme was introduced by the **Government of India** to promote **solar power generation** at the household level and provide free electricity to homes using renewable energy.
 
• It focuses on increasing the adoption of **solar panels**, particularly rooftop installations, to reduce dependency on conventional power sources and promote sustainability.
 
 
 
• **Solar Power in Gujarat:**
 
 
• Gujarat has taken a leading role in solar energy production, contributing significantly to India's renewable energy targets. The state has a dedicated focus on increasing the share of **solar energy** in its power grid.
 
• The state’s flagship solar projects include the **Charanka Solar Park**, which was inaugurated in **2012** and has been a model for other states in India.
 
• **Rooftop Solar Initiatives:** Gujarat has incentivized rooftop solar installations, making it easier for households to switch to renewable energy under the **PMSGMBY**.
 
 
 
• **Comparison with other states:**
 
 
• **Maharashtra:** While Maharashtra is a leading state in overall energy production, its contribution to solar energy is growing but not as significant as Gujarat's.
 
• **Uttar Pradesh:** Uttar Pradesh is focusing on solar energy adoption but faces challenges such as land availability and infrastructure development.
 
• **Tamil Nadu:** Tamil Nadu is a leader in wind energy and has significant solar installations but does not surpass Gujarat in solar power generation.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **India's Solar Energy Mission:**

 
 
• India aims to achieve **280 GW of solar energy capacity** by **2030** under its **National Solar Mission.**
 
• Solar energy is seen as a critical component of India’s commitment to the **Paris Agreement** and its **renewable energy goals.**
 
 
 
• **Economic and Environmental Benefits:**
 
 
• Solar energy reduces reliance on fossil fuels, lowering **carbon emissions** and contributing to a **sustainable energy future.**
 
• It provides cost-effective electricity to households, industries, and agricultural sectors, boosting **economic growth.**
